name: Harissa
recipeIngredient: 150g dried red chillies (ancho or New Mexico variety)

recipeInstructions.text: Remove stems and seeds from dried chillies. Soak in boiling water for 20 minutes until fully soft.
recipeInstructions.name: Rehydrate

recipeInstructions.text: Dry-toast caraway seeds in a small pan over medium heat for 1 minute until fragrant.
recipeInstructions.name: Toast

recipeInstructions.text: Drain chillies and blend with garlic, caraway seeds, coriander, cumin, olive oil, salt, and lemon juice until smooth.
recipeInstructions.name: Blend

recipeInstructions.text: Transfer to a jar, cover with a thin layer of olive oil to seal. Refrigerate for up to 2 weeks.
recipeInstructions.name: Store

description: Smoky, fiery North African chile paste. The backbone of Tunisian cooking — use it in dressings, marinades, and anywhere heat and depth are needed.
